heading: Havertown · Five outings, six street targets · Nov 2–6
summary: Sunday’s actual run missed Gladstone and added partial Wilson Drive coverage. Keep Monday Walnut/Covington and Tuesday Wilson; Gladstone moves to Wednesday, Grove stays Thursday and Rodmor moves to Friday.
